mechanism: Polyethylene glycol (PEG)-based solutions can cause fluid shifts and electrolyte depletion, potentially reducing enalapril efficacy and increasing hypotension risk in ACE inhibitor-treated patients.
action: Monitor blood pressure and renal function closely during PEG administration; ensure adequate hydration and electrolyte repletion; consider temporary dose adjustment of enalapril if hypotension or hyperkalemia develops.
